# RweruSynapse

RweruSynapse is a software company based in Kigali, Rwanda, building software solutions, research, and a community for Rwanda and Africa. We design products for real African conditions — intermittent connectivity, multilingual users, mobile-first access — and publish research and writing on engineering, product design, and digital systems across the continent.

## Key pages

- Home: https://rweru.com/ — Overview of RweruSynapse and what we build.
- Solutions: https://rweru.com/solutions — Software solutions we build for organizations across Rwanda and Africa.
- Research: https://rweru.com/research — Research and writing on African digital systems and product design.
- Use Cases: https://rweru.com/use-cases — Examples of products and platforms delivered for real organizations.
- Community: https://rweru.com/community — A community where Africans learn and contribute to software together.
- Company: https://rweru.com/company — About RweruSynapse, our team, and our mission.
- Blog: https://rweru.com/blog — Notes on engineering, research, and community from RweruSynapse.
- Contact: https://rweru.com/contact — Get in touch with RweruSynapse.
